marketing.metaTitle: GateSathi — Har entry, har bachcha, surakshit | Free Digital Visitor Register for Government Schools
marketing.metaDescription: GateSathi is a free digital visitor register for government schools in India (सरकारी विद्यालयों के लिए निःशुल्क डिजिटल आगंतुक रजिस्टर). Har entry, har bachcha, surakshit.
marketing.heroSubtitle: GateSathi is a free digital visitor register for government schools.
marketing.problem1: Heavy paper register that is slow to fill and impossible to search.
marketing.problem2: No way to know who met which child at the school gate.
marketing.problem3: Principal has no live view of who is inside the campus.
marketing.how1Desc: The guard enters the visitor's 10-digit mobile number at the gate.
marketing.how2Title: 2. Photo + student linked, guardian list checked
marketing.how2Desc: A live photo is taken, the student is selected, and the approved guardian list is verified.
marketing.how3Desc: The principal sees every gate entry and who is currently inside in real time.
marketing.f6: Works in Hindi on any basic phone.
marketing.p2: Built for the DPDP Act 2023 and Rules 2025.
marketing.p4: Photos are stored privately; only the school can see them.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This is a plain-language draft privacy policy for GateSathi, designed in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 and Rules 2025.
privacy.s1Body: We collect only the minimum information required for student safety at the school gate: visitor name, 10-digit mobile number, live visitor photo, linked student(s), purpose of visit, and entry/exit timestamps. We do not collect Aadhaar numbers and do not use facial recognition.
privacy.s2Body: The database is hosted in India (Mumbai). All student, guardian, and visitor records belong solely to the respective school.
privacy.s3Body: Photos are stored privately; only the school can see them. Visitor records are kept for up to 180 days, then deleted.

gate.title: Gate Entry Desk
gate.consentHi: क्या एकत्र किया जाता है: आपका नाम, मोबाइल नंबर, लाइव फ़ोटो और प्रवेश/निकास समय। क्यों: सरकारी विद्यालय के छात्रों की सुरक्षा और अभिभावक सत्यापन के लिए। प्रतिधारण: 180 दिनों तक सुरक्षित रखा जाता है, फिर हटा दिया जाता है। पहले हटवाने के लिए विद्यालय से संपर्क करें।
gate.consentEn: What is collected: Name, mobile number, photo, and entry/exit timestamps. Why: Student safety and guardian verification at the school gate. Retention: Kept for up to 180 days, then deleted. Ask the school to delete it earlier.
